describe: The image shows a top-down battlefield ground map. Pale blue-white mist and bright yellow-tan ridges run diagonally from the top left, the top is green grass with brown patches, and the centre is tan and brown earth. Two small wooden buildings with dark roofs sit at lower left and lower right, joined by a dark curved trench. This is a texture sheet of a few large pieces, so every piece must stay exactly in place.
